'''Whiphids''', or simply a '''Whiph''', were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] of large, [[Hair|furry]] [[Humanoid|bipeds]] that had two large ivory tusks protruding from their lower jaws [[Homeworld|native]] to the frozen [[planet]] [[Toola]]. [[J'Quille]] and [[Valarian]] were both Whiphids.

==Biology and appearance==
Whiphids were tall, bulky [[Humanoid|bipeds]] covered in long, coarse [[Hair|fur]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> which made up shaggy fur coats that protected the species from the freezing weather of their [[Water|ice]] and snow habitat.<ref name="VE" /> Whiphids possessed a skeleton that included a back spine.<ref name="Tempest Runner">''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]''</ref> The Whiphid face, which featured retractable [[eye]]s, bowed cheekbones and a prominent forehead, was mostly hairless. Two large,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> up-turned ivory<ref name="Smugglers Guide" /> tusks sprouted from the lower jaw.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> [[Youngling]]s were much less hairy than their elders.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> One particular individual, an adult male named [[J'Quille]], stood two [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Their ivory tusks were a desirable material in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Smugglers Guide" />

==Whiphids in the galaxy==
{{Quote|I once saw him pull out a Whiphid's spine with his bare hands. You should have heard that Whiph squeal. I vowed I'd never be in a situation where I'd be the Whiph.|[[Andrik Keller]], on [[Sslanno]]|<ref name="Tempest Runner">''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]''</ref>}}
Shortly before the onslaught of the [[Clone Wars]], a young Whiphid named [[Jempa]] was training as an [[Jedi Initiate|initiate]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] of [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Bear Clan">{{Databank|bear-clan|Bear Clan}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War]], the Whiphid [[Crime lord|crime lady]] [[Valarian]] operated on [[Tatooine]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. Her lover, a fellow Whiphid named J'Quille, infiltrated the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of her rival, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />
